FIRE ENGULFS DPWH BUILDING IN QUEZON CITY 🔥🚒🚨

The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bureau of Research and Standards (BRS) Building at Brgy. Pinyahan along EDSA, Quezon City caught fire on Wednesday, reaching a third alarm before firefighters put it out just before 2:00 p.m.

📸: Manny Palmero
